review: Dieci Yi Sang is a tank ID whose tankiness comes in the form of gaining barrier upon discarding a skill. Unfortunately he does not do anything else besides that as his sinking application is not great but he does synergize with it, althought he is on the same slot as spicebush Yi sang for sinking. His s1 and s2 has okay clashing power being at 13 and 16 but his s3 is quite conditional with him having to be under 50% hp just to reach 16 clashing power while rolling 12 normally, you are better off discarding than using it.His support passive thought can be really good with discard IDs, such as Molar outis, Dieci rodion but ultimately Dieci Hong lu will benefit the most from this passive since he discards the highest rank skill giving him the most shield No notable E.G.O Synergy
